userGuideModal.title: Super Digger ・ User Guide
userGuideModal.intro: Enter an investment topic you're interested in, and the AI will generate an in-depth analysis report for you.
userGuideModal.topicDescription: Suitable for analyzing macro themes, industry trends, news events, or any investment concept you are interested in. You can enter text, paste news links, or article content, and the AI will generate a multi-dimensional investment analysis report based on the latest information.
userGuideModal.topicExample: e.g., "Investment opportunities in AI Agents", "Key points from NVIDIA GTC 2024", "https://..."
userGuideModal.searchDescription: Enable real-time search in API Settings to automatically fetch the latest web results for your topic before analysis; all citations are listed at the bottom of the report. Two providers are supported: Exa (requires an API key from exa.ai) and AnySearch (free anonymous tier works without a key; add a key for higher quota).
userGuideModal.searchExample: The "Real-time Search Sources" card in the report shows each cited page title, domain, and publish date so you can verify data freshness.
userGuideModal.newsDescription: The homepage aggregates Xueqiu, Huxiu, Geek Insight, Bloomberg, Buzzing, Ahead of AI and more, and supports adding custom RSS feeds via "+ RSS". Click "AI Concept Tags" to batch-extract tradable concept tags for current news; click any tag to launch a dig analysis. With "Auto" on, tags are extracted automatically when switching sources. Each article also has one-click analysis.
userGuideModal.newsExample: Example: a foldable-phone launch article gets a "Foldable Display" tag — click it to analyze the supply-chain opportunity.
userGuideModal.historyDescription: Every analysis is saved to history, with both the investment attractiveness score (orange) and information gap score (black) shown as badges. Sort by Newest / Score / Info Gap to surface high-value leads. Click any entry to reopen the full report, or hit the refresh button to re-analyze the same topic with fresh data and compare score changes.
userGuideModal.historyExample: Example: "Solid-state batteries" scored 90 on info gap a week ago but drops to 40 on re-analysis — the market has priced it in.
userGuideModal.modelDescription: Open API Settings to configure your AI model. Cloud APIs: OpenRouter, DeepSeek, MiniMax, Ollama, or any OpenAI-compatible service. Local CLI: 9Router (a local gateway aggregating 60+ providers), Claude Code, and Codex — the app auto-scans local services and shows their status. All settings stay in your browser.
userGuideModal.modelExample: Example: npm i -g 9router, run it, then pick the 9Router preset under "Local CLI" to auto-connect to localhost:20128.

aboutPage.title: User Guide
aboutPage.subtitle: Your Intelligent Investment Research Assistant
aboutPage.purposeText: "Super Digger" is an intelligent investment research tool designed to transform complex, unstructured financial news, research reports, or market themes into clear, multi-dimensional investment strategy analysis reports using cutting-edge AI technology. Our goal is to help investors save time, quickly grasp key information, discover potential investment opportunities, and understand the associated risks.
aboutPage.feature1: Four-Dimensional Integrated Analysis: Reports provide a comprehensive investment perspective by analyzing from four dimensions: macro & policy, industry & supply chain, company fundamentals, and market sentiment to help you find opportunities in US, HK, and A-share markets.
aboutPage.feature2: Structured Report Output: AI analysis results are presented in a structured format, making the content clear and easy to understand, moving away from lengthy and complex texts.
aboutPage.feature3: Data Visualization: Tools like industry chain diagrams and stock association graphs make data and relationships clear at a glance.
aboutPage.feature4: History & Playback: Automatically saves your analysis history for easy review and comparison at any time.
aboutPage.feature5: One-Click Export: Easily export complete analysis reports as high-fidelity images or HTML web reports for sharing and saving.

thermometer.title: Market Thermometer
thermometer.subtitle: Valuation x sentiment framework: the Buffett indicator sets the risk zone (slow variable), AI scans news for institutional top signals (fast variable), combined into a 0-100 exit-pressure score.
thermometer.noApi: Configure an AI model in API Settings first
thermometer.buffettHint: Historical percentile of market cap / GDP (P90 = higher than 90% of history).
thermometer.notScanned: Not scanned yet. Click the button above to scan all news sources for institutional behavior signals.
thermometer.disclaimer: This gauge combines AI interpretation of public news with a manually entered valuation percentile. Research reference only, not investment advice. Major tops are rare events — treat this as a position-sizing input, not a sell-everything switch.

taco.title: TACO Cycle Monitor
taco.subtitle: Tracks the tariff-game cycle (threat -> panic -> walk-back) via AI news scanning, plus the crowding of the TACO trade itself — the more famous the pattern, the faster its alpha decays and the higher the "no chicken-out this time" reputation-repair risk.
taco.complacencyNote: Warning: markets have learned to ignore threats — TACO consensus is crowded. Watch for a credibility-restoring "no chicken-out" event (negative-skew risk).
taco.quietNote: No active tariff-game cycle in the current news window.
taco.decayHint: Blends media density of the TACO meme itself (60%) with market numbness to threats (40%). Higher = the pattern is common knowledge, less edge remains, fatter left tail.
taco.noApi: Configure an AI model in API Settings first
taco.disclaimer: AI interpretation of public news; the phase reflects the current news window only. Past validity of the TACO pattern does not guarantee the future — the one failure may cost far more than all prior small wins. Research reference only, not investment advice.
